$comment: Which [environments.<env>] sections of a knowledge base's config each Node service reads. Two consumers: the TypeScript config loader (packages/core), which resolves a section's ${VAR} references only when a service reads it and refuses a read of a section its service does not list here; and the launcher (apps/launcher), which forwards to each service only the variables its listed sections reference. `gateway` includes its legacy spelling `backend`. The Rust gateway is not here: it reads the document the launcher writes for it.
